ctx.x: Well, the Mercury Theater changed its name, see. The Mercury Theater was bought out by the concessioners there, which was Larry and Maggie Fields. It's known as the Abbey Theater now. And New York University has some leases on it, see. We have been invited to return, you see. Lady D. Bradley and the Chuck Green -- (Reminiscing with Chuck Green, you see, of Tap Happening and the Hoofers, you see.

And we haven't been into some works about this. And I mean, even this (unintelligible) this television producer of "What's My Line," and "To Tell The Truth." Mimi O'Brien. She told me about any other possibilities -- to be sure to let her know. And I've been in the process myself of letting her know, see, about these -- to tell the truth, you see.
Can you tell us what happened, why did the show close at the Mercury Theater?
